items.fdcDescription: Soup, vegetable broth, ready to serve
items.notes: Explicit destination review accepts ready-to-serve vegetable broth as the generic liquid vegetable-stock reference. Stock/broth wording is treated as the same plain vegetable liquid category for nutrition only; exact salt level, concentration, brand formulation, homemade reduction, added fat, and recipe-specific seasoning are not certified. No powder/cube reconstitution, density, or concentration conversion is inferred.

The target does not specify meat, poultry, fish, or vegetable stock, so no species or formulation is certified. This binding applies only to plain liquid stock; cube, powder, concentrate, and alternatives such as 'stock or water' remain separate unresolved identities.

Explicit destination review uses retained grated Parmesan as a bounded hard Italian grana-cheese nutrition fallback for Grana Padano. This is not a claim that Parmesan and Grana Padano are the same protected cheese; exact aging, moisture, salt, milk provenance, rind treatment, and brand formulation are not certified. The fallback is limited to generic per-100-g nutrition and does not infer grated piece weight or serving conversion.
